description: Main application component for the Decision Helper web app, handling state management, UI rendering, and user interactions for decision making, criteria, options, scoring, rankings, and exporting data.

methods.name: uid()
methods.description: Generates a reasonably unique ID for client-side entities based on timestamp and random number.

methods.name: clamp(n, min, max)
methods.description: Clamps a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: toNumber(value, fallback = 0)
methods.description: Safely parses a value into a number, with a fallback.

methods.name: normalizeWeights(criteria)
methods.description: Computes normalized weights for criteria so that their sum equals 1, or zeros if total is zero.

methods.name: computeTotals(decision)
methods.description: Calculates total normalized scores for each option based on criterion weights and scores.

methods.name: rankOptions(decision)
methods.description: Ranks options based on their computed total scores, descending order.

methods.name: createDecision(name = "New Decision")
methods.description: Creates a starter decision object with default criteria and options.

methods.name: loadState()
methods.description: Loads persisted state from LocalStorage, with validation and fallback to default state.

methods.name: BarChart({ rows, maxValue = 100 })
methods.description: Renders a simple inline SVG bar chart for visualizing rankings.

methods.name: EmptyState({ title, description, action })
methods.description: UI component for displaying empty state messages with optional action.

methods.name: Modal({ title, children, onClose, footer })
methods.description: Reusable modal dialog component with close behavior on Escape or overlay click.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React component orchestrating decision, criteria, options, scoring, ranking, chart view, and export functionalities.
